items.title: Global Health in Practice: Investing Amidst Pandemics, Denial of Evidence, and Neo-dependency
items.creator: Olusoji Adeyi
items.note: Likely the single most relevant book. Adeyi (Nigerian, former World Bank health director) argues the core problem is neo-dependency on the Global North. Pairs with Dead Aid.

items.title: Diaspora for Development in Africa
items.creator: Sonia Plaza & Dilip Ratha, eds.
items.note: At minimum: Ketkar & Ratha's chapter on diaspora bonds, and Clemens's chapter on the financial consequences of African doctors emigrating.

items.title: Diaspora Networks and the International Migration of Skills
items.creator: Yevgeny Kuznetsov, ed.
items.note: India and Israel comparators. Frames diaspora networks as a bridge between insiders with risk-mitigating knowledge and outsiders with capital.

items.title: Innovative Financing for Development
items.creator: Suhas Ketkar & Dilip Ratha, eds.
items.note: Foundational text on diaspora bonds, including India's and Israel's programs.

items.title: The Nigerian Healthcare System: Pathway to Universal and High Quality Health Care
items.creator: Joseph Abiodun Balogun
items.note: Reference text for system structure. Skim rather than read cover to cover.

items.title: An American Sickness
items.creator: Elisabeth Rosenthal
items.note: How each sector (hospitals, insurers, pharma, devices) makes money. The best single primer.

items.title: Redefining Health Care
items.creator: Michael Porter & Elizabeth Teisberg
items.note: Origin of the value-based care vocabulary consultants use constantly.

items.title: The Pyramid Principle
items.creator: Barbara Minto
items.note: How consultants structure arguments. Worth reading before starting full time.

items.title: The Healing of America
items.creator: T.R. Reid
items.note: Compares national health system models; bridges into the global work.

items.title: Getting Health Reform Right
items.creator: Roberts, Hsiao, Berman & Reich
items.note: The control knobs framework (financing, payment, organization, regulation, behavior). Common language on World Bank health teams, and useful for the capstone framework too.

items.title: Say It with Charts
items.creator: Gene Zelazny
items.note: How to build slides that make one point each.

items.title: The McKinsey Way
items.creator: Ethan Rasiel
items.note: Quick read on consulting problem-solving habits.

items.title: The World's Banker
items.creator: Sebastian Mallaby
items.note: Inside the World Bank under Wolfensohn. Good YPP prep on the institution's culture and politics.

items.title: The Billion Dollar Molecule
items.creator: Barry Werth
items.note: Narrative of drug development; read if pursuing life sciences.

items.title: The hidden force in global economics: sending money home
items.creator: Dilip Ratha · TED
items.note: Watch this first: the primer on why remittances matter.

items.title: Nigerian doctors working in the UK say they're being exploited
items.creator: BBC Newsnight
items.note: Surveyed 188 resident medical officers: 92% recruited from Africa, 81% from Nigeria. Useful for the recruiting-agencies angle.

items.title: Stranded: Exposing the UK's immigration scammers
items.creator: BBC Africa Eye
items.note: Olaronke Alo investigates rogue agents exploiting gaps in the UK care-sector job market.

items.title: Reinventing global health in Africa and the developing world
items.creator: Brookings webinar
items.note: Launch event for Adeyi's book; panel included CUGH's Keith Martin. Transcript available if you'd rather read.

items.title: Back to the Motherland
items.creator: Pamela Sakyi
items.note: How government actors pitch diaspora engagement; features Ghana's High Commissioner to the UK.

items.title: The Way Back
items.creator: Shana Simmons Zougbo
items.note: Follows one diasporan family returning under Ghana's Year of Return. Lighter on policy; good for identity questions.

items.title: Sick Around the World
items.creator: PBS Frontline
items.note: Compares how five wealthy countries run universal coverage.

items.title: Unnatural Causes
items.creator: PBS series
items.note: The classic on social determinants of health; relevant to the Fund for Health role.

items.title: Poverty, Inc.
items.note: Critique of the aid industry. Pairs with Dead Aid and Adeyi; connects career and capstone.

items.title: Escape Fire
items.note: Critique of US health care incentives; a companion to An American Sickness.

items.title: The Crime of the Century
items.creator: HBO
items.note: Pharma, regulators, and the opioid crisis. Watch if life sciences is on the table.

items.title: Dialogues: a conversation with Olusoji Adeyi
items.note: WHO/TDR podcast.

items.title: African solutions to African health system challenges
items.note: Adeyi on ending dependency on foreign public-health funding, and why it weakens leaders' financial responsibility.

items.title: The Telemedicine Renaissance in Nigeria, Part 1
items.note: Temitope Coker's show on founders, investors, and policymakers shaping African health systems.

items.title: The Return
items.note: Audio documentary. Dr. Ashley Milton travels from Cape Coast to Tema meeting African Americans now living in Ghana.

stories.title: UBA and ANPA Diaspora Healthcare Investment Platform
stories.summary: UBA presented a framework at the ANPA Carolinas Symposium to channel diaspora funding into specialist hospitals, diagnostics, telemedicine, and medical training. A live case of the investment-not-donation thesis.
keywords: Association of Nigerian Physicians in the Americas

stories.title: Nigerians in Diaspora Day 2026
stories.summary: This year's theme: harnessing global diaspora medical expertise to strengthen local health systems.

stories.title: Minister Pate on diaspora health insurance
stories.summary: Suggested diasporans pay for relatives' health insurance rather than sending money when someone falls ill. Shifts remittances from consumption toward investment.

stories.title: African Medical Centre of Excellence, Abuja
stories.summary: A quaternary hospital developed by Afreximbank and King's College Hospital London. A strong case study for the medical tourism thread.

stories.title: Coming soon: The Walls of Nations by Michael Clemens
stories.summary: Listed as forthcoming from Columbia University Press. It will move to your Books list when it's out.
